name: SplitText-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the finished headline and subline cleanly, with no cursor over the controls.

tagline: Headline letters rise into place one after another.
summary: A heading and a smaller line split into individual characters or words, then fade and lift into position in sequence as they enter the viewport. A replay button restarts the entrance.
appearance: A large white bold headline reading "Every letter has a story." sits above a smaller grey line, both centred on black, with a tiny outlined Replay control at the lower right. Mid-animation the same words show with letters missing and blurred edges.
behaviour: When the text scrolls into view each letter, or word, lifts and fades in with a short stagger from first to last. The replay control reruns the sequence, and the scroll trigger only fires once.
demo_content: "Every letter has a story." over "Watch them arrive one by one." with a Replay button.
search_phrases: letters fade up one at a time
headline that animates in on scroll
animated heading for a landing page
use_when: A hero or section heading should arrive with a crafted, sequential reveal as it scrolls into view.
avoid_when: It needs GSAP and ScrollTrigger and starts hidden, so a failed script can leave the heading unseen.
customise: Set text, tag, splitType (chars, words, lines, words and chars), delay, duration, ease, from and to tween values, threshold, rootMargin and an onComplete callback.
weight_why: One GSAP timeline per text block that runs once and then idles.

a11y.note: The text reads normally to assistive tech, but the entrance ignores reduced motion and is invisible until the script runs.

issues: Heading stays invisible until GSAP and webfonts finish loading.
polish_why: Crisp type and a smooth stagger; the blank wait before the letters start is a little long.
